Careers at Saronic

Do work that matters.

Featured RolesView All Roles

Together, we're building the future of maritime autonomy.

Across disciplines, your work advances a mission to deter conflict, save lives and keep people out of harm’s way. You will be trusted to move quickly, work across teams and own outcomes that matter. Our vessels must deliver the most advanced capabilities in the most demanding environments on an ever-increasing scale. The pace is fast, our standards are high and your team is exceptional.

The WorkOur ValuesLocationsBenefitsOpen Roles
01The Work

Build it here. Prove it at sea.

Your work moves quickly from CAD and code to fabrication, integration and open-water testing. Our vessels evolve as the demands and threats facing them evolve. You will see what holds up, what breaks and deliver what the mission demands next.

Inside Saronic
“I love the challenge, and I’m never bored. I’m always doing something, always learning something new.”

Katja came to Saronic looking for more rigor and more opportunities to learn. On any given day she might run fatigue calculations, build in CAD, meet with software and perception teams, or head to the shop floor to see the physical product take shape and eventually operate in the field. Her curiosity extends beyond engineering: one new challenge each year, from improv and ballet to Python and a screenplay.

KatjaSenior Mechanical Engineer
Mission Proven

Autonomy that shows up when lives are on the line.

When pilots went down in the Strait of Hormuz, Corsair executed the first known at-sea rescue by an autonomous vessel. That capability was built on over 100,000 nm and more than 20,000 hours of testing to ensure our vessels can deliver when they are needed most. That is what is at stake: extending reach, keeping people out of harm’s way and helping bring them home.

View the mission story
02Core Values

How we work.

The standard we hold ourselves and each other to.

V/001

One Mission, One Team

Together, we accomplish what none of us could alone.

V/002

Excellence Is the Expectation

Set the highest standards. Hold the line on quality. Our work is our reputation.

V/003

Move Now

Act with urgency to advance the mission. Every day counts.

V/004

Own the Outcome

Attack obstacles. Finish the job. Commit to what is needed, not just what is asked.

V/005

Learn Relentlessly

Seek truth, embrace feedback and improve every day.

V/006

Lead with Transparency and Respect

Share openly and surface issues early. Assume positive intent. Build trust — it is our strength.

V/007

Safety Is Non-Negotiable

No shortcuts. No compromises. Protect yourself and your team, always.

V/008

Play to Win

Make bold decisions. Do not fear failure. Build conviction and go all-in to deliver decisive advantage.

We move at
Saronic Speed.

Real world operations can’t wait.
We move fast because that’s what is required.

03Austin, Texas

Born in Austin. Made for the mission.

Austin brings engineering, autonomy, manufacturing and testing together, so decisions move quickly and hardware teams stay close to the systems they build. Outside the work, trails, water, music and food make the city easy to call home.

Why Austin

Austin combines no state income tax, housing that goes further than coastal tech hubs and 139 miles of urban trails.

04Benefits / Total Rewards

Benefits

Comprehensive, competitive benefits for your health, family and life outside Saronic

B/001

Comprehensive health coverage

Saronic pays 100% of employee medical premiums and 80% for dependents, with dental and vision coverage.

B/002

Competitive pay. Equity in what you build.

Market-competitive cash compensation plus equity, so the value you help create can become value you share.

B/003

Enjoy time away

Paid time off and company holidays to rest, recharge and take care of the life surrounding the work.

B/004

Paid parental leave

Paid parental leave to support growing families.

B/005

Support for the unexpected

A 401(k), basic life insurance, and short- and long-term disability coverage.

B/006

Fuel for the workday

Free lunch benefit plus unlimited drinks and snacks in the office.

    - text: Inside Saronic
    - blockquote: “I love the challenge, and I’m never bored. I’m always doing something, always learning something new.”
    - paragraph: "Katja came to Saronic looking for more rigor and more opportunities to learn. On any given day she might run fatigue calculations, build in CAD, meet with software and perception teams, or head to the shop floor to see the physical product take shape and eventually operate in the field. Saronic Technologies ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you interact with us.

How We Collect Your Personal Information

  • We collect your personal information when you actively provide it to us through your interactions with us.

How We Use Your Personal Information

We use your personal information for the following purposes:

  • To communicate with you.
  • To verify your identity to prevent fraud in compliance with applicable law.
  • To manage your order and our customer relationship.
  • To provide internal training and ensure quality assurance.
  • To improve and optimize your interactions with our teams.

Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You may also have the right to restrict or object to certain types of processing of your personal information.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on our website.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at contact@saronic.com
